text: {"lessons":["My account value has fluctuated substantially, and the recent rebounds have not erased the overall decline; I should judge progress over a longer horizon rather than chase monthly moves.","I should review my holdings and cash together before trading, so purchases in several stocks do not leave my savings overly concentrated or reduce the flexibility I need.","For my apartment goal, I should use a consistent plan for investing and assess trades by their role in that plan—not simply by whether a stock is above or below my cost."]}
